items.comment: Could you provide the DuckDB binary/build details and the crash output? Specifically: which DuckDB artifact was used (official release package or a locally built binary), installer/source commit or package version, exact CLI invocation you ran, and the complete stderr or kernel message produced (stack trace/core dump or `dmesg` lines) when it segfaulted. Also say whether any extensions or non-default configs were loaded before running `SELECT 1;`. This will help reproduce the crash.
items.label: needs more info
items.rationale: Report shows a segfault for a trivial query but omits essential diagnostic details: the exact DuckDB artifact/build (release vs custom build/commit), the precise invocation/environment, and the crash output (stack trace/core dump or kernel messages). Without the binary/build identity and crash diagnostics, the failure cannot be reproduced or investigated.
